title: We won the Cultural Connections call from the Dutch Embassy & Consulate in Brazil with 'Ponte em Cena' — a bridge between theatre and innovation
subtitle: In a series of workshops throughout 2026, Regen Studio and (in)PULSO will test a new method for bridging cultures, with the help of theatre and innovation exercises.
featuredImageAlt: A painterly low-poly composition in cream, peach and mint facets. Centred: a small bridge with a triangulated truss coloured green, gold and orange — the project mark of Ponte em Cena — on ink piers. Above it, the white wordmarks of Regen Studio and (in)PULSO sit side by side.
excerpt: In a series of workshops throughout 2026, Regen Studio and (in)PULSO will test a new method for bridging cultures, with the help of theatre and innovation exercises — pairing Augusto Boal's participatory-theatre tradition with Dutch-origin consensus-based decision-making. Funded by the Government of the Netherlands under the Cultural Connections 2026 call.
